post.excerpt: Fogos.pt, a volunteer-run wildfire tracker in Portugal, grew from a side project into a critical national resource used by citizens, media, and government. During 2025 fire season it was hit by DDoS attacks, but stayed online thanks to Cloudflare’s protections under Project Galileo.How a volunteer-run wildfire site in Portugal stayed online during DDoS attacks
post.title: How a volunteer-run wildfire site in Portugal stayed online during DDoS attacks
